blocks.text: Critical issues are collected across role results. _hard_safety_check enforces the loop cap, periodic human checkpoints, and repeated critical-failure pauses before any model judgment.

blocks.text: The controller stops on token budget or majority failure, optionally accepts Laya's stop verdict, otherwise asks the gatekeeper for an explicit STOP or role list and emits the decision.

blocks.text: run_with_looping documents forwarded context and its normal or paused return shapes. Each pass builds a hires graph and forwards approval, domain, scope, owner, and tab context.
blocks.title: Loop contract and graph execution

blocks.text: When execute_graph pauses, the controller adds macro-loop state to the existing paused snapshot and returns a paused response without merging the incomplete pass.
blocks.title: Pause snapshot enrichment

blocks.text: Completed pass results are merged, the last finished role is tracked, and expert/beast decisions select bounded redo passes. Completion clears scratchpad state and returns results plus final_role.
blocks.title: Redo and completion

gotchas: Only explicit CONTINUE with existing roles can trigger another pass.
The hard cap stops at MAX_MACRO_LOOPS.
A paused pass is returned before its partial results are merged.
how_it_works: Applies hard cap and human-pause safety checks
Uses Laya and a gatekeeper for continuation
Rebuilds graphs for selected redo roles
outputs: completed role results and final role
purpose: This controller wraps execute_graph with a bounded expert/beast macro-loop. It checks deterministic safety rules before asking a gatekeeper whether to stop or redo selected roles, preserves loop state across approval pauses, and clears scratchpad state after completion.
summary: Runs hires-driven execution passes with optional macro-loop review, safety breakers, pause recovery, and role-specific redo.
